hard_preconditions: no SEALED sample or SEALED-named materialized path is present
pass_conditions: optimizer updates equal ceil(selected TRAIN observations / accumulation)
pose and camera projection heads both receive finite non-zero gradients
Camera-B subject-macro point-to-triangle result is finite
median Camera-B rendered-depth coverage is at least 0.05
checkpoint head tensors survive an exact save/load round trip
failure_policy: Stop. Keep the report and checkpoint marked research-only; do not start the formal pilot.
claim_limit: PASS means the governed one-epoch path works. It does not establish improvement, generalization, clinical accuracy or READY_TO_TRAIN.
